title: Duress Passwords at the Border: A New Privacy Precedent
excerpt: A US citizen's use of a duress password to wipe his phone during a border search has sparked a high-stakes legal battle. This case challenges the balance between government authority and digital privacy, highlighting the risks travelers face from rising CBP device searches.
